title: Quality findings must be precise and blocking, never advisory WARNs
what: The overengineering guard was changed from a WARN on every new file with <= 1 consumer to an ERROR only for new code with zero non-test consumers; unknown cases (entry points, unresolved languages, framework attributes) stay silent; escape is anvil-allow(overengineering): reason.
why: Anvil's goal is code quality with minimal slop; noisy warnings fired ~11 times per check on normal code and were ignored. Precision over recall.
learned: Calibrate every new rule against real recent commits before shipping; Rust `mod foo;` is a file import edge and must not count as a consumer; shared test helpers imported only by differently named tests are test support, not dead code.
author: reactive-end
